chapter: Band family, war years and wrap-up
title: Gigging during the Depression
summary: The school provided meals and tutors on trips.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: But, you know, you were gigging during this time. You were playing. What was it like in that regard?
You were playing during that time.
During the Depression. Well, it was pretty rough cause of the way we had to travel. And then, during that time, the

school looked out for us. In other words, they gave us meal money, and they saw that we were taken care of whatever city we went to. They had someone, advance people to take care of all that. They made it nice. We didn't have too rough of a time.
So, it didn't have too much of an effect?
So, it didn't have too much of an effect on you as a bandsman or a band leader or anything like that?
In other words, cause the hardest thing was going in and trying to get back in class in the morning early when we came off those gigs, you know.
know, we were sleeping and tired too.
Then, we went out for the school. You know, they had tutors. Then we'd come back. If we got there at 8:00, you had to go to class before you could get some sleep.
